content_language.description: The language the accounts being searched for publish in (an ISO 639-1 code) — the «local» language of the subject's audience, never the report's locale.language. The candidate collector searches in it. Write it on every plan.

market_tokens.description: Optional. The compact market word(s), in the market's own spelling, that this plan wrote into both local lanes because the Request names a market. Profile search strips exactly these words.

popular_topic.description: Optional, category lanes only: a two-to-four-term Instagram topic for Popular Search. Omit it to reuse a search_query of up to four terms. Workflow lanes carry none: a buyer workflow phrase is not an Instagram topic, and Popular Search returns not found for it.
